curated_by: Fly-a-Kite (manual adjudication from upstream labels, fault_model, and issue threads)
purpose: Paper-facing impact/severity classification and root-cause independence analysis (A1/A3). Does not change upstream confirmation status or the confirmed count.

datafusion-grouped-null-topk-001.independence_note: Distinct mechanism from the DISTINCT variant: here a plain grouped MIN/MAX drops the whole NULL-key group; the DISTINCT root fails to retain a NULL group key outside the non-NULL heap.

datafusion-limit-offset-pushdown-001.first_violated_component: LimitPushdown optimizer (outer OFFSET propagated into child subtree)
datafusion-limit-offset-pushdown-001.independence_note: Differs from the idempotence root: this one shrinks an inner LIMIT using a handled outer OFFSET; the idempotence root merges a repeated LIMIT with stale OFFSET state.

datafusion-negative-zero-comparison-001.independence_note: Unique numeric-semantics root; no shared subsystem with any other confirmed family.

datafusion-distinct-null-topk-001.independence_note: Same subsystem (TopK NULL handling) but a distinct fault model (DISTINCT retention vs grouped drop).

datafusion-ordered-limit-idempotence-001.first_violated_component: Repeated ordered LIMIT merge with stale OFFSET state
datafusion-ordered-limit-idempotence-001.independence_note: Same subsystem (LIMIT/OFFSET planning) but a distinct fault model (idempotence vs pushdown shrink).

polars-grouped-max-sort-metadata-001.independence_note: Upstream P-high/accepted; independent of all DataFusion families.

polars-reflected-arithmetic-operand-orde.independence_note: Upstream P-medium; Python-dispatch semantics, not a query-planning root.

pyarrow-sliced-bool-hash-aggregate-001.independence_note: Arrow in-memory layout root; unreachable by SQL-only or DataFrame-API-only techniques.

duckdb-join-filter-pushdown-limit-001.first_violated_component: runtime join filter pushdown across ORDER BY/OFFSET/LIMIT
duckdb-join-filter-pushdown-limit-001.independence_note: Discovered only through a metamorphic semi/anti-join rewrite relation, not a SQL value oracle.

polars_vector_division_rounding@polars.reason: upstream closed as invalid / duplicate of #23741

datafusion-order-by-offset-subquery-grou.reason: open, self-labeled, no maintainer acknowledgement / assignment / PR / independent label event

dedup_summary.note: The two paired groups share a subsystem but have distinct fault models and first-violated components; the paper reports both 9 roots and 7 coarse groups.
